thread:
Ava (platform eng): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime section — a few clarifying Qs on perf tradeoffs we promised to answer here.

Priya (vp-eng): Short answers: kernel perf work is top priority for Q2->Q3. We'll ship kernel-v5 canary next week. Batching autotune is in beta; KV eviction gets a separate RFC.

Marco (eng-runtime): Canary for kernel-v5 starts 1765890000. Primary changes: fused-attn kernel + reduced kernel launch overhead. Expect ~8-12% p95 improvement on long prompts. We'll be A/B'ing mem usage.

Sofia (ml infra): Quantization profile PR coming today. Note: int8 -> ~3-4% deterministic NLL increase on eval set, but <1% impact on chat-quality metrics. We'll flag model-specific guidance.

Liam (sre): For SLOs: we'll keep default latency SLO at 200ms p95 for short prompts. Canary will have stricter monitoring. Set alerting so regression >=5% triggers rollback.

Jasmine (product): Customers asked about cost vs latency knobs — can we publish recommended presets (low-cost / balanced / low-latency)?

Marco (eng-runtime): yes, presets are coming. Current plan:
- low-cost: batch_size=64, cache_prefetch=on, quantize=dynamic
- balanced: batch_size=32, cache_prefetch=on, quantize=static
- low-latency: batch_size=8, cache_prefetch=off, quantize=none

Priya (vp-eng): We'll publish presets alongside the Optimize UI. ETA end of month.

Ava (platform eng): Quick technical Q — how will batching autotune behave under mixed sequence lengths? e.g., 16-token vs 1024-token mix.

Marco (eng-runtime): Autotuner uses percentiles of seq length per route. Rule of thumb: it keeps two active batch strategies (short vs long) and assigns reqs based on recent 1m window. We'll expose route-level override.

Sofia (ml infra): Note: KV cache TTL is request-scope by default. We can expose a route param kv_ttl_ms. Default: 300000 (5m). Eviction is LRU per host.

Liam (sre): Operationally, we need an evict-low-hit-ratio policy. Suggestion: auto-evict keys with hit_rate<0.02 after 30m. Marco?

Marco (eng-runtime): OK, adding evict-low-hit-ratio to RFC. Also will add metrics: kv_hits, kv_misses, kv_entries per route.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/kernels/v5 -> prod-canary at 2026-04-10T15:00Z :rocket:

Ava (platform eng): One more — fallback routing: if kernel-v5 memory spikes, do we fallback to kernel-v4 or to quantized variant? What's priority?

Marco (eng-runtime): Priority: same-architecture non-quantized (v4) -> quantized variant of v5 -> region fallback -> deny. Fallbacks are pluggable per route.

Priya (vp-eng): For Dedicated customers we will offer pinning to kernel versions. We'll also share a compatibility matrix.

Jasmine (product): I'll draft the customer-facing note and add presets + upgrade guidance.

Ava (platform eng): Thanks. Action items: Marco -> RFC for kv-evict + metrics; Marco/Sofia -> quantization guidance doc; Priya -> publishing timeline; Jasmine -> customer note. Ping me if stuck. :thumbsup:
